signals.title: Interpretation of Survival Outcomes in Multicancer Early Detection Testing Requires Caution
signals.ai: The caution in interpreting survival outcomes from multicancer early detection testing highlights the need for careful evaluation of biomarkers used in these tests to ensure accurate screening results.

signals.title: On the Distinction Between Prognostic and Predictive Inference in Multicancer Early Detection
signals.ai: The study clarifies the distinction between prognostic and predictive inference in multicancer early detection, enhancing the accuracy of liquid biopsy tests for identifying cancer biomarkers.
